QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] Half-Hearted Halflingers
QuestInfo.0: Crow wants to talk to you. What could he want this time?
QuestInfo.1: Crow actually seems concerned about the Halflingers in Leafre. He's asked you to go check on #e#bIto#k#n for him.
QuestInfo.2: Halflingers who have come in contact with a Mystic Gate seem to be suffering from fatigue. Could the Mystic Gates be sapping their energy?

0.0: Numbskull, get over here.\r\n#L0##bWhat do you want? I'm busy doing important things!#l\n#k
0.1: Relax, dimwit, I need a favor.\r\n#L0##bWhat kind of favor, jerkface?#l\n#k
0.3: I'm an elite member of the Silent Crusade! I don't have time to babysit a town full of overgrown hairballs! Go find out what's going on!

yes.0: I know the bosses gave you a job to do out here, for some reason, but #eIto#n could really use a check in.

no.0: Why are you being so difficult today?

0.2: The fuzzballs seem really...weird lately. They're all moping around, napping on the streets. Not that I care, but it's really strange.\r\n#L0##bWhy don't you look into it yourself, if you're so in love with the Halflingers?#l\n#k

1.0: The poor little guy has been so tired ever since he got near that Mystic Gate, huh?\r\n

yes.0: Hey, you did a good thing. Don't let it go to your head. I'll call if I ever need you again.

default.0: We can't spend all day hanging out here. Go see #eIto!
